input.query: SELECT signup_month, channel, n_signups, n_email_verified, n_kyc_started, n_doc_submitted, n_kyc_approved, n_first_topup, n_activated, n_activated::DOUBLE/n_signups AS activation_rate FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month IN (DATE '2026-03-01', DATE '2026-04-01') ORDER BY signup_month

SELECT signup_month, SUM(n_signups) n_signups, SUM(n_activated) n_activated, SUM(n_activated)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) activation_rate FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND signup_month <= DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT channel, signup_month, n_signups, n_activated, n_activated::DOUBLE/n_signups rate FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE signup_month IN (DATE '2026-03-01',DATE '2026-04-01') ORDER BY channel,signup_month
